ns2:course.label: Ed Prac Students with Sp Needs
ns2:course.description: Course in practice teaching which provides teaching experience with exceptional children. May be repeated for 18 hours, 12 of which may be taken in the same term. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Satisfactory completion of all requirements of the Council on Teacher Education Undergraduate or Graduate Common Assessment Plan for Initial Certification (http://www.ed.uiuc.edu/cte/cap).
